notes.title: CARDMON 1.2 RELEASED
notes.content:
Hello fellow carders!

This update is to resolve bugs, so here's a list:

[list]
[*]Adjusted NPC hitboxes
[*]There were some achievements that wouldn't pop in certain circumstances, now this is fixed
[*]Fixed a bug with the dialogue box
[*]Adjusted some damage multipliers
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WsBTKw3.png[/img]

notes.title: CARDMON 1.1 RELEASED
notes.content:
The new version of the game is already out, check what has been added!
[list]
[*] Added an exp bar during encounters.
[*] Added a symbol next to the attack that shows if it's going to be effective or not depending of the type of the attack and the enemy CARDMON.
[*] Adjusted the exp needed for leveling up at higher levels.
[*] Some minor bugs fixed.
[/list]

[url=https://i.imgur.com/bAItfOU.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/bAItfOU.png[/img][/url]
